subject: Cross-cloud SI demo: block booking & runbook
messages:
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aperture.io>; Ravi Subramanian <ravi.subramanian@aperture.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-cloud SI demo: block booking & runbook

Hi Emily / Ravi —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-present. We want to lock a multi-region demo window that covers an AWS (us-east-1) + Azure (westeurope) flow so we can show Redwood Dedicated routing + private VPC pathing in the same run. Goal: 45–60 minute session (20m demo, 20m SI deep-dive, 15–20m Q&A).

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–11:00
- Wed May 26, 08:30–09:30
- Thu May 27, 14:00–15:00

I attached a first-pass runbook and an agenda template. Can you confirm which slot works for your SRE and solutions lead? Also let me know whether Paul (AWS) should be looped in — I can invite him if you want marketplace visibility.

We’ll run the demo from Redwood Dedicated in us-east-1 and route a traffic leg through Azure West Europe to show multi-cloud fallback. The deliverable is a co-branded recording and a short enablement doc for Aperture pre-sales.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment: runbook-draft-v1.pdf (18KB)
Attachment: agenda-template.odt (6KB)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aperture.io>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>; marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Subramanian <ravi.subramanian@aperture.io>
Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud SI demo: block booking & runbook

Grace —

Appreciate the clear options. Wed May 26, 08:30 PDT works for our team (that’s 11:30 EDT / 16:30 BST for Ravi and the SRE). Paul from AWS would be great to have for marketplace mention — I’ll forward and ask for availability.

Two quick asks:
1) Can we extend the demo to 75 min to allow 25–30m of SI deep-dive? Our SRE wants extra time for troubleshooting steps.
2) We’ll need a short network diagram to prep our infra folks — happy to fill in a template if you can share one.

I’ve copied Ravi (SI lead). He’ll confirm attendees and whether they prefer to run any of the demo from Aperture infra.

—Emily
Emily Chen
Partner GTM, Aperture Solutions
Emily.Chen@aperture.io

Subject: Re: Cross-cloud SI demo: block booking & runbook

Emily / Grace —

Confirmed from our side: Wed May 26, 08:30 PDT is blocked (I’ve tentatively placed a calendar hold). We can stretch to 75 minutes — good call. Grace, can your team update the runbook to reflect a 75-minute timing and add a short network diagram (1 slide)? That will keep the flow: intro (10), demo (25), SI deep-dive (30), Q&A (10).

Logistics notes for the runbook:
- Primary host: Redwood Dedicated (us-east-1)
- Failover route: Azure West Europe (RB routing policy)
- Recording + post-demo asset: co-branded Loom + short one-page enablement
- Tech contacts: Grace (redwood), Ravi (aperture), Karthik (redwood infra)

I’ll create a shared folder and post the final runbook. Also looping Aditya for marketplace packaging notes — Aditya, can you prepare a short blurb about the AWS marketplace listing and any SSO considerations?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Marissa — Wed 26 works. Small ask: our SRE is in India and prefers 14:30 IST (which is 02:00 PDT) — that won’t work. Can we keep the 08:30 PDT slot but please add a short tech rehearsal 60 minutes prior (07:30 PDT)? Ravi will join the rehearsal. Also, we’ll run one portion (the Azure failover test) from an Aperture test account — we’ll share credentials in the secure folder.

We’re happy to have Paul from AWS on the call; he asked for a short list of the marketplace callouts (pricing, lead flow, SSO) — can someone from Redwood prepare that (Aditya as mentioned)?

Thanks —

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. Calendar is updated: final session Wed May 26, 08:30–09:45 PDT (75m) with a tech rehearsal 07:30–08:15 PDT. Calendar invite has the rehearsal conferencing link and the demo link; recording will be on.

Next steps (ACTION ITEMS):
- Grace (me): update runbook with 75m timings, add network diagram slide, upload to shared Drive (by EOD today)
- Aditya: short marketplace callout doc for Paul (pricing/lead flow/SSO) — request by EOD today
- Ravi: share Aperture test credentials in the secure folder and confirm Azure test account details (by 12:00 PDT Wed)
- Marissa: final co-branding checklist and recording rights confirmation

Paul — welcome aboard. If you prefer a separate 15-min sync pre-demo for marketplace talking points, flag a time and we’ll schedule it.
